purpose: Canonical definitions for the GP Attraction Analytics Dashboard.

conversion_funnel.description: Ordered conversion from opportunities visit through tool completions to EOI submit

drop_off_stages.description: Where sessions leave the funnel or abandon tools

high_value_traffic_paths.description: Paths that disproportionately reach EOI submit

persona_engagement.description: Engagement and completion by persona hint

metrics.label: Opportunities page visits
metrics.definition: Count of page_view where surface = gp_opportunities

metrics.label: Funnel step sessions
metrics.definition: Distinct sessions reaching each ordered funnel step (any prior order allowed; step attributed on first qualifying event)

metrics.label: Opportunities → EOI conversion
metrics.definition: sessions with eoi_submit / sessions with opportunities page_view

metrics.label: Tool abandon rate
metrics.definition: sessions with tool_start and no tool_complete / sessions with tool_start (per toolId)

metrics.label: CTA clicks
metrics.definition: cta_click events on GP attraction surfaces

metrics.label: Path lift to EOI
metrics.definition: (EOI rate among sessions containing path P) / (overall EOI rate among opportunities sessions)
metrics.note: Highlight paths with lift ≥ 1.5 and minimum sample size

metrics.label: High-value traffic paths
metrics.definition: Most common surface sequences among sessions that submit EOI (length 2–5)

metrics.label: Entry surface EOI rate
metrics.definition: EOI rate grouped by first GP surface in session

metrics.label: Persona session share
metrics.definition: Share of sessions by personaHint (including unknown)

metrics.label: Persona tool completion
metrics.definition: tool_complete / tool_start by personaHint and toolId

guardrails: Do not publish public % earnings or commercial rates derived from analytics.
Suppress cells with session count < 5 in persona and path tables.
Label persona as hint / self-select — not a verified identity.
Dashboard is practice-internal; not a recruitment agency scoreboard.
